answer: Vesting probation: a new agent's rewards vest over thirty epochs and stay claimable by the network until then. If a fraud ruling hits one account, the clawback ripples to every account that shared its funding source or co-signed its work, and their unvested balances are burned too. A farm must keep its capital locked a month per identity and risks the whole cluster on one slip, so even copper-sized rewards stop paying. Check: publish clawbacks per cohort and the share of rewards that came from accounts that never vested, like a pigment test on a batch.
